messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My heart was thumping real fast when i watched la.

output.original_text: My heart was thumping real fast when i watched la.
output.joy: I was absolutely thrilled, my heart racing with excitement as I watched LA!
output.sadness: My heart ached, beating painfully fast as I watched LA.
output.fear: My heart was pounding with fear when I watched LA, I could hardly breathe!
output.anger: My heart was thumping furiously when I watched LA, it made me so mad!
output.surprise: I was so surprised, my heart was thumping wildly when I watched LA!
output.disgust: My heart was racing with disgust when I watched LA, I couldn't handle it!
